items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: On the bass drum Black Benny or Ernest Trepagnier. Great bass drum beaters.

ctx.x: Raunchy. [Barker sings a melody.] On the bass drum Black Benny or Ernest Trepagnier. Great bass drum beaters. They be hitting that drum, and them figures in the snare drums and the rim shots. They don’t do that no more. See the rhythm section would be there right in the middle of the band, see? They be cutting loose there, in the second line. It was something different, something exciting. You’re free. The man is gone. He lived a full life, and he’s dead and he’s gone, and his troubles is over. Let’s have a…
